title: Identity and certificate check of every received line
setup: All purchased and fabricated lines delivered to the receiving bench with their packing documents.
steps: 1) Match every delivered item to its BOM id and exact_order string; 2) verify manufacturer marks/certificates (material certs for custom steel/aluminium); 3) record serials/lot codes; 4) quarantine mismatches.
acceptance: Every delivered item matches its exact BOM identity; certificates present where the row claims them; mismatches quarantined, never substituted.

title: First-article dimensional inspection of custom parts
instruments: CMM or height gauge + micrometer; surface plate
setup: First article of each custom family (H001-H007, F1xx, M2xx, P001-P008, AX parts).
steps: 1) Verify every controlled dimension on the released drawing; 2) record measured vs nominal with instrument id; 3) check critical fits (bearing pockets H7, 20 h6 spindle) individually; 4) record capability notes where the drawing demands them.
acceptance: All controlled dimensions within drawing tolerance; fit-critical dimensions measured with micrometre-class instruments; records include measurement uncertainty.

title: Price/evidence reconciliation of the purchase set
setup: Invoices/packing lists for the delivered set available.
steps: 1) Run tools/reconcile_bom.py; 2) match each invoice line to its BOM row and dated observation; 3) record the realised basket price at actual purchase quantity; 4) flag every deviation from the observation (price/MOQ/quantity).
acceptance: Every cost line has a dated source and matches its BOM occurrence; deviations recorded; blank never treated as zero (handoff 12.3).

title: MOQ/pack and spare-quantity verification
steps: 1) Count delivered vs BOM quantity and declared MOQ/pack; 2) record spares received; 3) record any forced over-purchase and its unit-cost effect.
acceptance: Actual purchase quantity and unit cost recorded per line; over-purchase effects included in the cost rollup.

title: Conformance of fabricated assemblies to released drawings
steps: 1) Check assembly identity against the drawing revision; 2) verify weld/heat-treatment records where stated; 3) verify surface finish/coating; 4) photograph and file the as-built state.
acceptance: As-built matches the released drawing revision; deviations require an approved change record before use.

title: Bearing-seat interference measurement (matched pairs)
instruments: micrometre (0.001 mm class); bore gauge; temperature log
setup: Housing/adapter seats and shaft journals at measurement temperature 20-25 C recorded.
steps: 1) Measure each seat and journal diameter at 3 positions x 2 directions; 2) compute actual interference per pair; 3) record the remaining bearing internal clearance envelope; 4) store measured pairs as the permanent record.
acceptance: Actual interference 3-6 um per pair with documented measurement uncertainty; CNC access is not accepted as 1 um capability; remaining bearing clearance inside the manufacturer envelope (G16).

title: Collar/keyway fit and torque-set record (F109)
steps: 1) Assemble per instruction; 2) apply the specified clamp torque with calibrated wrench; 3) mark fastener positions; 4) run slip/settlement screening (static torque then reversal).
acceptance: No slip at 5 N.m service torque with the 7 kN class clamp recorded; settlement marks stable; fretting inspection after the screening (G19).

title: Screw/journal runout and end-machining conformance
steps: 1) Measure journal runout and diameter (8 h7 x 18 ends); 2) verify thread forms; 3) record straightness at mid-span.
acceptance: Journals within h7; runout within drawing; end machining matches the one frozen configuration (10 mm lead, 1000 pulses/rev).

title: Holder/tooling preload and fastener torque audit
setup: Head assembled with production fasteners (exact class/length from the manual).
steps: 1) Torque every fastener to the manual value (or record PENDING->resolved value); 2) verify thread engagement (15 mm nominal where stated); 3) re-check after a run-in cycle.
acceptance: Every fastener at its documented torque with engagement verified; no fastener left at a guessed value.

title: Coupling alignment and runout under rotation
steps: 1) Check angular/parallel alignment at the coupling; 2) rotate by hand through full travel; 3) record runout at the screw journal.
acceptance: Alignment within the coupling manufacturer's limits; no binding through full travel.

title: Rail/block preload and stage parallelism
setup: Rails mounted on the base plates.
steps: 1) Measure rail straightness and height match; 2) verify block preload class; 3) measure carriage parallelism across travel.
acceptance: Machined-section stiffness claim requires the measured stage geometry; parallelism within the drawing (G14 evidence input).

title: Assembly cleanliness and void inspection (cast/epoxy features)
steps: 1) Inspect filled regions for voids where the process includes them; 2) record mass vs nominal; 3) verify edge breaks/deburring.
acceptance: No void above the drawing limit; mass within process tolerance; no sharp edges at wire/handling paths.

title: Fuse/breaker time-current curve capture on the DC branches
instruments: programmable DC load; oscilloscope; current shunt
setup: Branch built on a bench with production wire lengths and terminations.
steps: 1) Capture trip curves at 1x/2x/5x rated; 2) repeat at 40 C ambient; 3) record breaking events at the declared voltage (36 V and 60 V cases).
acceptance: Measured curves match the released selection within the declared tolerance; no undocumented substitution (G32).

title: I2t and let-through measurement at fault current
setup: Bench fault path with metered energy.
steps: 1) Apply the declared fault case; 2) record let-through I2t; 3) compare with wire and terminal I2t limits.
acceptance: Let-through I2t below every downstream wire/terminal limit with margin recorded.

title: PSU-limited fault clearing verification
setup: PSU in its real current-limit behaviour with the branch connected.
steps: 1) Apply output faults the PSU can limit; 2) verify the protection clears or limits as designed; 3) record nuisance trips.
acceptance: Every PSU-limited fault either clears the protection or is demonstrably limited below hazard; no nuisance trip in normal load steps.

title: Input vs output protection separation audit
steps: 1) Trace every branch to its protection device; 2) verify no common-mode path couples input and output protection; 3) verify selective coordination where required.
acceptance: Branch separation as designed; no protection device silently shared between the safety input and output sides.

title: Conductor sizing and terminal torque verification
steps: 1) Verify wire gauge/length per the released wiring schedule; 2) torque every terminal to its spec; 3) pull-test crimps sample-wise.
acceptance: Sizing and torque match the electrical release; crimps pass pull test; the release document is the authority (manual warns against guessed values).

title: Contactor DC make/break on the 36 V branch
setup: K1-K3 exact catalogue topology, real bus capacitance connected.
steps: 1) Cycle make/break at rated and fault load; 2) record contact bounce/arc events; 3) count operations to the declared life screening.
acceptance: Adequate DC make/break proven for the exact topology; AC ratings never accepted as proof (G31).

title: Contactor DC make/break on the 60 V branch
setup: As P03-T1 at the 60 V branch and its capacitance.
steps: 1) Repeat make/break at 60 V with inrush; 2) record worst-case bus overshoot.
acceptance: Worst-case make/break within device ratings with recorded margin; bus overshoot within branch component voltage classes (G31/G33).

title: Capacitive inrush measurement at bus energisation
steps: 1) Energise and record inrush waveform; 2) compare with device make-rating; 3) verify the soft/precharge design if used.
acceptance: Peak inrush within the device make-rating or limited by the designed precharge; no undocumented reliance on wiring resistance.

title: Relay/contact life screening with welded-contact detection
setup: Safety and power relays in their real circuits.
steps: 1) Run the life screening duty; 2) after each block verify NO/NC continuity; 3) verify the controller detects welded contacts (indirect monitoring) and faults.
acceptance: Welded/stuck contacts are detected and safe; no auto-restart after a welded-contact fault (G35/G36).

title: Field-input wetting-current verification (57.9 uA defect fix)
setup: Production field-input circuits (couplers into RP2350 pins).
steps: 1) Measure the available wetting current with the production pull configuration; 2) verify internal pulls are disabled where required; 3) verify margins over the relay/contactor minimum wetting spec.
acceptance: Wetting current above every relay minimum with margin; the old 57.9 uA at 3.3 V case may never recur (G44).

title: ALM/STO interface behaviour under driver fault
setup: All four axes connected with real ALM lines.
steps: 1) Inject driver faults; 2) verify ALM latency and controller fault latching; 3) verify drive-disable force-off behaviour including welded relay simulation.
acceptance: Every driver fault reaches a safe torque-off state within the documented latency; ordinary MCU/relay paths are never claimed as certified STO (G35/G40).

family: P04 safety circuits and system integration
title: Dual-channel E-stop loop validation
setup: XPSUAF13AP with both channels, real buttons/contacts.
steps: 1) Open each channel independently; 2) verify drop-out and diagnostic response; 3) verify no single fault defeats the function; 4) record response times.
acceptance: Dual-channel function with single-fault tolerance demonstrated at the wiring/component level; a competent safety engineer signs the final PLr validation (G35).

family: P04 safety circuits and system integration
title: Guard-door loop and guard release validation
setup: Final guards fitted with their switches/interlocks.
steps: 1) Open each guard path; 2) verify stop category and energy removal; 3) verify release only after safe standstill; 4) verify power-loss direction is safe; 5) verify manual recovery for welded contacts.
acceptance: All reachable openings covered; release cannot occur with hazardous energy present (G34/G36).

family: P04 safety circuits and system integration
title: Stored-energy discharge verification with the retained bleed hardware
setup: Every DC branch with its exact retained bleed/absorption components.
steps: 1) Charge to operating voltage; 2) remove supply and record bus decay; 3) verify voltage below the declared safe-touch threshold within the declared time; 4) repeat at 40 C.
acceptance: Deterministic measured decay per branch; power-taper arguments never accepted as discharge proof (G33/G36).

family: P04 safety circuits and system integration
title: As-built wiring audit against requirements/signal-table.md
steps: 1) Point-to-point verify every signal in the table; 2) verify polarity/active levels; 3) verify the handling channels fail closed if unassigned; 4) photograph and label.
acceptance: Every signal physically verified and labelled; no signal represented only by a spare input or boolean default (M27 signal contract).

family: P04 safety circuits and system integration
title: Mains dip/interruption and restart behaviour
steps: 1) Apply declared dips/interruptions; 2) observe controller/safety behaviour; 3) verify restart requires the documented recovery (rehome/rethread) and never resumes a half-known part.
acceptance: Safe behaviour across the declared mains envelope; no uncommissioned motion after recovery (G40/G44).

family: P04 safety circuits and system integration
title: EMI immunity smoke-test (conducted/radiated spot checks)
setup: Machine running a duty cycle with handling verification active.
steps: 1) Inject declared EMI profiles at pre-compliance levels; 2) observe false counts, encoder errors, handling faults; 3) record all anomalies.
acceptance: No false accepted pieces or lost handling evidence under the declared profile; anomalies drive design fixes and retest (G44).

family: P05 structural load and proof tests
title: Head axial proof load 2500 N (double) with geometry check
instruments: load cell 5 kN; dial indicators; fixture
setup: Head assembled on its real supports with measuring instrumentation.
steps: 1) Load to 5000 N axial in the worst sign; 2) hold per procedure; 3) record deflections; 4) unload and check permanent change; 5) repeat other signs.
acceptance: No permanent change; deflections inside the model-validated envelope; the complete load path (blocks/nut/supports/receivers/bolts/base/tooling) instrumented (G12).

family: P05 structural load and proof tests
title: Head transverse proof load 750 N (double)
steps: 1) Apply 1500 N transverse both directions; 2) record deflection/recovery.
acceptance: No permanent change; residual within measurement uncertainty (G12).

family: P05 structural load and proof tests
title: Head vertical proof load 375 N (double)
steps: 1) Apply 750 N vertical both directions; 2) record deflection/recovery.
acceptance: No permanent change (G12).

family: P05 structural load and proof tests
title: Feed fault-torque load case 5 N.m with full rotor-role modelling check
steps: 1) Apply the 5 N.m fault case to the worst path; 2) record deformations; 3) verify current/torque tolerances above nominal are represented.
acceptance: Structure survives the fault case without permanent change; the 2.5x running reversal case also demonstrated (G13).

family: P05 structural load and proof tests
title: Belt load case +/-480 N and roller cases +/-60 N both planes
setup: Cassette with final belt and rollers.
steps: 1) Apply the belt loads both signs; 2) apply roller loads both planes; 3) include the 75 N nip upper case; 4) record deformations.
acceptance: All cases pass; no analysis capped at 60 N may erase the 75 N nip case (G13).

family: P05 structural load and proof tests
title: 4900 N support vs 5000 N proof contradiction resolution
setup: Custom axis support component at final configuration.
steps: 1) Apply the proof load per the released procedure; 2) if the component rating is below the proof load, document the engineering resolution (derate/replace/redesign) before any use; 3) record the decision in the change log.
acceptance: The contradiction is resolved by engineering change, never by rounding; until then the axis is not released (G37).

family: P05 structural load and proof tests
title: Post-proof metrology re-verification
steps: 1) Re-run the fit/gap/geometry measurements; 2) compare before/after; 3) quantify any change with uncertainty.
acceptance: Post-proof geometry equals pre-proof within measurement uncertainty (G12/G22 input).

title: Nip force calibration over OD and travel (each of four nips)
setup: Each nip individually accessible; OD gauges across 1.2-4.5 mm.
steps: 1) Measure force at min/nom/max OD at both travel ends and mid; 2) repeat after 500 cycles for hysteresis; 3) record temperature.
acceptance: Each nip 50-75 N (target 60 N) across the declared envelope; no averaging of nips (G23).

title: Measuring-wheel force and loaded-circumference calibration
steps: 1) Measure wheel force 6-19 N each; 2) run the loaded-radius calibration against an independent reference; 3) record loaded circumference per wheel/OD.
acceptance: Each wheel 6-19 N (target 10); calibrated counts/metre frozen with its uncertainty; encoder starting torque effects recorded (G24).

title: Belt tension and both tension stations
steps: 1) Set and record tension 180-200 N (target 190) at each station separately; 2) re-check after a thermal cycle and after 1000 cycles.
acceptance: Both stations within range with the re-check drift recorded; access method documented (G28).

title: Feed drag/friction measurement (no-wire and threaded)
steps: 1) Measure breakaway and running drag unthreaded; 2) repeat threaded at min/max OD; 3) separate roller, bearing and seal contributions.
acceptance: Drag budget recorded and consistent with the traction model inputs (G23/G24).

title: Loaded-radius wear/drift envelope screening
setup: Wheels after the P14 duty block.
steps: 1) Re-run loaded-radius calibration; 2) measure tread wear; 3) compare with the 0.1056 mm allowed radius loss at the 8 kHz ceiling.
acceptance: Radius loss stays within the M36 envelope or the ceiling/calibration is re-qualified (G10/G24).

title: Takeaway/output mechanical resistance (slide/conveyor)
steps: 1) Measure the force/behaviour to carry 200-3000 mm parts clear of the discharge zone; 2) verify the ejection grip-loss region (tail past X140) is covered by the takeaway; 3) record timing into the clear window.
acceptance: Every supported length clears the discharge zone within the evidence window without manual help (G08/G43).

title: Strand-integrity microscopy on cut ends
setup: Coupon matrix across 0.5-2.5 mm2, min/max OD and risky intermediates.
steps: 1) Cut coupons per recipe; 2) image both ends; 3) count nicked/severed strands; 4) record blade state and cut count.
acceptance: Zero nicked/severed strands at qualified blade life; vision/count presence is never the acceptance basis (G03).

title: Jacket/end criteria inspection
steps: 1) Inspect insulation ends for tear/ragging/deformation; 2) inspect incision depth quality; 3) record against the declared criteria.
acceptance: All ends meet the declared criteria across the coupon matrix (G03).

title: Strip dimension measurement per end
steps: 1) Measure strip length per end from cut-end datum to insulation edge; 2) compute error vs command; 3) record at 20 C with instrument uncertainty.
acceptance: |error| <= 0.20 mm per enabled end with |e|+U<=T satisfied; disabled ends stay disabled (G02).

title: Blade edge-life coupon progression
setup: Blade set tracked by cut count.
steps: 1) Run coupons through the life progression; 2) measure edge radius/wear at intervals; 3) correlate with cut-quality criteria; 4) define the replacement limit.
acceptance: Replacement limit defined from measured correlation; regrind procedure and its effect recorded (G03).

title: Cut-force envelope measurement
setup: Head instrumented across the material envelope.
steps: 1) Measure cut force per material/OD/temperature; 2) record the envelope; 3) compare with hot axis capability.
acceptance: Measured envelope inside actual hot axis capability with margin recorded (G21).

title: Loaded blade-face gap measurement and shim record
steps: 1) Measure the loaded face gap at the wire; 2) derive the allowed interval from cut-quality data; 3) execute and record the shim procedure; 4) re-check after proof loads.
acceptance: 0.020 mm nominal under load with the interval derived from quality data; complete loaded chain represented (G22).

title: Prime-stub removal verification (10 mm stub, 75.5 mm nip gap)
setup: Waste sweep installed; chute sensor live.
steps: 1) Run prime passes across conditions; 2) verify each stub transits the chute (present->clear) before the next feed; 3) verify a stub never attempts the nip path; 4) simulate blocked sweep and verify the fault.
acceptance: 100 % stub transits or the machine faults before further feed; no accepted count from a trapped stub (G43).

title: Slug removal verification 3-25 mm including adhesion/static
setup: Strip recipes across the range; environmental cases.
steps: 1) Run stripped pieces; 2) verify lead and tail slugs transit; 3) stress adhesion/static/curl cases; 4) verify debris control.
acceptance: Every slug cleared before the next blade close; worst-case adhesion/static handled (G43).

title: Part present->clear evidence window (edge cases)
instruments: logic analyser on the channel; camera
setup: Discharge sensor installed; controller logging enabled.
steps: 1) Run parts that clear early, late and just-in-window; 2) inject bounce/double/stuck-high/stuck-low; 3) verify acceptance only for plausible transitions inside the window; 4) verify quarantine otherwise.
acceptance: Acceptance exactly matches the physical history; disabled/hardcoded channels can never produce acceptance (G43/M27).

title: Output support and clearance 200-3000 mm
steps: 1) Run min/max length and asymmetric strips; 2) verify positive support and clearance; 3) verify 3 m parts never overhang unsupported into hazard.
acceptance: All lengths supported and cleared; ambiguous outcomes go to quarantine, not acceptance (G08/G43).

title: Bin-full and jam recovery without finger access
setup: Deliberately full/jammed waste and output bins.
steps: 1) Fill the bins; 2) induce jams; 3) perform recovery per the manual with guards on; 4) record every tool access needed.
acceptance: Recovery possible per the manual without reaching into hazard; the manual needs no invented step (G34/G41/G43).

title: Interrupted-part recovery drill
setup: Stop/power loss at representative phase points.
steps: 1) Interrupt at each phase family; 2) execute the documented recovery (clear/rehome/rethread); 3) verify the prime classifies leftover bodies correctly (stub sweep vs scrap discharge).
acceptance: No half-known part is ever accepted; recovery is executable as written (M37/G40/G43).

title: Tooth-pass identification at operating speed
steps: 1) Measure the tooth-pass order from actual tooth counts; 2) compare with 79.5775 Hz nominal at 0.50 m/s; 3) map orders vs speed.
acceptance: Measured order matches geometry-derived prediction within instrument tolerance (G28).

title: Campbell map across speed/duty
steps: 1) Sweep speeds through operating range; 2) map crossing resonances; 3) record acceleration crossings and dwell risks.
acceptance: Speed/duty map excludes sustained resonance dwell with documented margins (G28/G45).

title: FRF measurement of the final assembled machine
steps: 1) Measure FRFs at tool, wire path and frame reference points; 2) record modes/damping; 3) update the model.
acceptance: Measured FRFs are the evidence for bandwidth and resonance claims; absolute frame acceleration is never the criterion (G45).

title: Relative tool-to-wire motion measurement
steps: 1) Measure relative displacement at the cut; 2) compare with the face-gap interval; 3) derive speed/duty limits.
acceptance: Relative motion keeps the loaded face gap inside its interval across the qualified map (G22/G45).

title: Damping confidence bounds and repeatability
steps: 1) Repeat FRF measurement n>=3 setups; 2) compute damping bounds; 3) feed the lower bound into the model.
acceptance: Damping used in analysis is the evidenced lower bound, not the measured mean (M13 evidence rule).

title: Regeneration bus-decay measurement per branch
setup: Each DC branch with final absorption/bleed.
steps: 1) Generate regeneration events at the declared energy; 2) record final bus voltage; 3) compare with V_final=sqrt(Vi^2+2E/C) prediction; 4) verify component voltage classes.
acceptance: Measured decay matches the model within uncertainty; no branch exceeds its protected rating; the 57.411 V class error can never recur (G33).

title: Bleed component verification and safe-touch timing
steps: 1) Record resistor temperature/duty at worst case; 2) record decay to safe-touch threshold; 3) verify relay logic isolates bleed where required.
acceptance: Safe-touch timing met with each term measured; resistor selection verified, not assumed (G33/G36).

title: Branch coordination under sequential faults
steps: 1) Apply sequential faults across branches; 2) verify selectivity; 3) verify no cross-trip or unsafe bus state.
acceptance: Coordination matches the released protection design (G32/G33).

title: Driver/ALM and axis-disable timing measurement
steps: 1) Measure disable/enable and ALM latencies; 2) verify against controller timing budgets; 3) verify no step pulse after disable.
acceptance: Latencies within documented budgets; no motion commanded after a latched fault (G40).

title: Counter wrap and long-run software behaviour
setup: Controller in fixture mode with simulated high edge rate.
steps: 1) Drive encoder counters across the 32-bit wrap (~58.2 h at 20500 edges/s); 2) verify counts/verification remain correct; 3) verify flash wear budget.
acceptance: No count/verification error across wrap; flash wear within budget (G40).

title: USB isolation and host-link fault behaviour
steps: 1) Disconnect/short USB during motion; 2) verify motion independence (host never required); 3) verify the 750 ms host-link timeout semantics.
acceptance: Machine operation is independent of the host; link faults never cause motion faults (G40/G42).

title: Risk-assessment review and PLr/SIL assignment
steps: 1) Run the documented risk assessment; 2) assign PLr/SIL per safety function; 3) record the competent safety engineer's identity.
acceptance: PLr/SIL derived from the risk assessment; no paper argument without the engineer's record (G35).

title: Safety-function validation per ISO 13849-1/-2
steps: 1) Validate each function against its PLr; 2) verify MTTFd/DCavg/CCF data from certified sources; 3) perform physical fault injection.
acceptance: Each function validated at its required PL with signed records; ordinary relays/MCU never assigned PL data without certified evidence (G35).

title: Common-cause and single-fault tolerance tests
steps: 1) Inject single faults (short, open, welded contact) per channel; 2) verify safety function remains; 3) record diagnostics coverage achieved.
acceptance: Single-fault tolerance demonstrated; CCF measures documented (G35).

title: Proof-test interval and manual warning finalisation
steps: 1) Derive proof-test intervals from the validation data; 2) put intervals and warning labels in the manual; 3) verify the manual states the payoff brake is not a safety brake.
acceptance: Manual contains only validated statements; every warning traceable to a hazard record (G35/G41).

title: Finished-length record: >=30 unique consecutive pieces per cell
instruments: calibrated gauge (U<=0.05 mm); thermometer; tension fixture
setup: Matrix cells: length 200/1000/3000 x strip settings x material extremes.
steps: 1) Run each cell uninterrupted with piece identities; 2) measure relaxed length at defined tension/temperature; 3) record residuals, failures and scrap; 4) run tools-level data check for gaps.
acceptance: |error| <= 0.20 mm + 0.05%*L with |e|+U<=T; >=30 unique consecutive pieces; failures/scrap retained (G01/G05).

title: Strip-length capability per end
steps: 1) Measure both ends per piece; 2) treat ends separately; 3) compute capability.
acceptance: Per-end Cpk >= 1.33 with the declared confidence treatment (G02/G05).

title: Capability statistics with predeclared conformity rule
steps: 1) Check distributions and autocorrelation; 2) compute Cpk with valid methods; 3) compute the proposed one-sided 95% LCB if adopted (D7).
acceptance: Cpk >= 1.33 per declared cell; nonnormal/autocorrelated data handled properly; 30 pieces treated as a minimum record, not rare-event proof (G05).

title: Gauge R&R and measurement uncertainty validation
setup: Length and strip gauges with operators.
steps: 1) Run gauge R&R; 2) build the GUM budget; 3) verify U<=0.05 mm for length; 4) verify conformity rule application.
acceptance: Measurement adequacy shown (target T/U >= 4 where applicable); decision uncertainty included (M31).

title: Tension-relaxation and thermal-drift validation
steps: 1) Measure relaxation under the defined low measuring tension; 2) measure length vs temperature; 3) validate the correction model with held-out data.
acceptance: Correction residuals validated on held-out data; no fit from a failed run accepted (M23/M31).

title: Correction residual vs external tolerance audit
steps: 1) Compare the controller's correction residuals with the external error; 2) verify internal limits are strictly smaller than external tolerances.
acceptance: The internal error budget stays below external tolerance; correction residual is never reported as accuracy (G01/M31).

title: Corner-length and interior maximum-error search
setup: Lengths at 200/1000/3000 plus interior candidates from the model.
steps: 1) Run the model-predicted worst interior lengths; 2) compare errors with the corner cases.
acceptance: No interior length exceeds the tolerance envelope predicted/verified at corners (G01).

title: Duty-specific endurance test (10,000 h / 1.8e7 cuts basis)
instruments: cycle counter; thermal log; maintenance log
setup: Machine at production duty with declared spectrum (0.5 cuts/s averaged).
steps: 1) Run the declared duty block(s); 2) record failures, interventions and wear; 3) track all scrap and rejects; 4) no unreported corrective actions.
acceptance: Duty achieved with recorded reliability basis; bearing L10 never substituted for machine life (G15/G46).

title: Wear-limit establishment (blades, wheels, nips, filters)
setup: Components tracked through the duty block.
steps: 1) Measure wear progression; 2) correlate with performance (quality/forces/flow); 3) define limits and intervals.
acceptance: Quantified wear limits and intervals with their evidence; spares list updated (G46).

title: Maintenance interval validation (lubrication/filters)
setup: As P14-T1 with the draft manual intervals.
steps: 1) Execute draft intervals; 2) record condition at each service; 3) adjust intervals from evidence.
acceptance: Intervals in the manual are evidence-based; adjusted where the data says (G46).

title: Replacement and requalification drill
steps: 1) Replace a wear part per the manual; 2) re-run the affected calibration/verification; 3) verify dependent evidence is invalidated and regenerated.
acceptance: Replacement invalidates and regenerates dependent calibration/evidence; machine returns to qualified state only after requalification (G46).

title: Service-effort and robustness measurement (U08)
steps: 1) Record service minutes and defect counts before/after the redesign where baselines exist; 2) record recovery actions.
acceptance: Robustness improvement is shown by measured service/defect data, never by inference from parts (U08/G46).

title: Independent build walk-through from the one PDF
setup: Complete kit of parts and the released Cutting_Assembly_Manual.pdf.
steps: 1) Builder assembles following only the PDF; 2) log every question/ambiguity and any need for a choice; 3) photograph each stage.
acceptance: Build completes without choosing geometry, wiring, torques, variants or parts; every ambiguity is designed out and the PDF revised (G41).

title: Torque/fastener/tooling audit during the build
steps: 1) Verify each fastener's documented torque is achievable with the listed tools; 2) verify tool access at every fastener; 3) record any infeasible step.
acceptance: Every documented torque is achievable with the listed tool in the listed access; manual corrections made otherwise.

title: Static and moving collision/integration check
steps: 1) Jog every axis through extremes; 2) check clearances incl. service/removal paths; 3) include tolerance extremes where adjustable.
acceptance: Continuous motion without collision; tool/cable access verified; no envelope-only claim (G25/G26).

title: Reel/payoff/buffer handling verification (<=30 kg)
setup: Payoff with min/max reel packages (decision D3 envelope).
steps: 1) Load/retain/brake both package families; 2) verify loading method incl. the lift; 3) verify empty/full/mid states and bend radii.
acceptance: Both declared reel families handled safely with the loading method in the manual and cost; photos are never ratings (U07/G27).

title: Final inspection, photo record and release checklist
steps: 1) Execute the release checklist; 2) record final photos; 3) verify every open gate in the manual's register is either closed or explicitly carried with its owner and due record.
acceptance: The manual's status may change only with signed records; nothing unverified is presented as complete (handoff 14).

title: 18 steady-state + 17 thermal-fault cabinet tests
steps: Generated by tools/generate_thermal_tests.py from the pinned handoff plans; see tests/P10-thermal/procedures.md (TS01-TS18 steady state, TF01-TF17 fault).
acceptance: Per-test acceptance in tests/P10-thermal/procedures.md; records ship executed=false.
